subject: general
question: What is RDX?

options.text: An instrument to measure blood pressure
A chemical used in the manufacturing of pesticides

solution:
The correct answer is __**An explosive.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• RDX is a **nitramine explosive compound **that can be utilized as a** propellant, gunpowder.**
 
• RDX **stands for Royal Demolition eXplosive**. 
 
• It is also called **cyclonite or hexogen**. 
 
• The chemical name for RDX is **1,3,5-trinitro-1,3,5-triazine.**
 
• It is a white powder and is very explosive.
 
• [IMAGE: https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSjYbaAv86K6LtH3Wm-kCZU1TWrjErNG7KbTA&usqp=CAU] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• To measure blood pressure, a doctor uses an instrument called **a sphygmomanometer.**​ 
 
• Pesticides made from **phosphoric acid** which meant to **control pest and weeds.**
 
• **An ammeter** is a measuring instrument used to** measure the current in a circuit.**
